Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on an apparent erroneous/vandalized Wikipedia infobox listing Myra’s birthplace as “Bergen, Norway” without qualification. This introduced the incorrect birthplace into the workflow, conflicting with multiple credible sources (e.g., IMDb FAQ and bio indicating California). This uncritical acceptance of a conflicting Wikipedia infobox is the first point where the path to the wrong answer (non-California) was set.
